status: registered before final complete same-input retest after v16 negative results and reproduced source-anchor parsing defect
concurrency_scope: Only the final Memoria framework; two isolated histories in parallel, questions serial within history.
baseline: Full visible conversation before question; drop oldest whole turns only if byte/window budget exceeded. Record every truncation.
memoria: Native Memoria with distinct bounded missing-demand probes, prior-gap reassessment, calendar-complete time answers, matching source-date explanation parsing and on-demand Reader format retry reservation.
judge: Independent binary LLM with frozen adapted permissive rubric; no arm label or evidence override. Gold used only after answering.
failure_policy: Planned IDs stay in denominator; unknown judge coverage and answer errors are separate. No filtered-accuracy promotion.
accounting: Every formation, consolidation, Reader, support, repair and grading call. Shared ingestion once per visible-history hash. Missing usage stays unknown; retained upper reservation is not an invoice.
resume: Not implemented. Keep checkpoints, isolated databases and append-only calls. New execution is a new charged run.
interpretation_limits: Repeated development sample; no unseen generalization or independent human labels.
One complete Memoria framework group; no four-arm experiment or pure causal attribution.
Same locomo-dialogue-and-blip-caption-v2 input as v15, with original question IDs, Judge, models and per-case caps unchanged.
Unanswerable reference labels may conflict with plausible original-text readings; report unchanged scores and AI-assisted source audit separately.
Official source IDs measure post-hoc visibility, not semantic necessity or sufficiency.
billing_policy: Two consecutive insufficient-balance responses open a global circuit; retain every planned ID as not_run. No automatic top-up or retry.
authorization: User requested substantial improvements, the original 36 questions and GitHub push. Internal mechanism diagnostics are allowed, but the final reported group must be Memoria only.

sampling.method: first two histories; four uniformly sampled questions per category per history; no answer/gold/failure filters

additional_changes: Use a distinct second probe only within the existing one-round/two-query limit; immutable original access filters and frozen question requirements remain authoritative.
Second Gate sees actual previous local binding gaps rather than repeating an indistinguishable assessment.
Reader resolves supported relative dates at source precision; support rejects a deictic time answer stripped of its calendar anchor.
Reserve complete Reader plus both support attempts before Gate; optional Reader format regeneration is reserved only when needed, always inside the same shared eight-call/240000-byte cap.
Revert the v16 broad referent-equivalence prompt after increased ordinary refusals; existing subject, condition, source integrity and independent support checks remain.

When a narrow source-date explanation actually matches the quoted original clock, separate that reference calendar from the derived event value for precision and year-arithmetic checks. Wrong anchors, wrong derived years and unframed contradictory dates remain blocked.
budget_note: One final complete 36-case retest after v16 ordinary regression and concrete source-anchor parsing defect. No selected-case retries; all v16 failures and unknown usage remain immutable. Same raw input and shared 8-call/240000-byte/8000-character caps.
